kamloops.title: Highway through Summerland, B.C., reopened with limited hours, stopping restrictions
kamloops.description: Every exit was blocked off with pylons, including entrances to local businesses, with some staffed by security guards to prevent people from pulling off the road.

kamloops.title: Meadow Valley resident stayed to save his home from wildfire: ‘This is my life’
kamloops.description: The Bald Range wildfire broke out near Summerland last Friday evening. Meadow Valley resident Tyler Wall said he knew he wasn't going to leave his home and business.

kamloops.title: Child dies after being hit by car at Abbotsford townhouse complex
kamloops.description: Anyone who witnessed the collision or who may have dash camera footage of the incident is asked to contact the Abbotsford Police Department at 604-859-5225.

kamloops.title: Man acquitted in murder of Winnipeg teen given 10 years for violent Vancouver sex assault
kamloops.description: Mark Edward Grant, who turns 63 on Friday, was originally charged with unlawful confinement, sexual assault with a weapon, assault with a weapon, and uttering threats.

kamloops.title: Wildfire smoke drives tourism to some B.C. communities
kamloops.description: As wildfire smoke blankets the province, people are travelling to find places with better air quality. It's led to a recent uptick in tourism for some communities.

kamloops.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 14
kamloops.description: The Regional District of Central Okanagan is pleading for patience from residents forced to flee their homes due to the Bald Range wildfire, saying it remains a dynamic and challenging fire.

kamloops.title: Lower Similkameen Indian Band wants B.C. to pause new mining claims in Ashnola watershed
kamloops.description: Lower Similkameen Indian Band (LSIB) says the province has stunted conservation efforts in the Ashnola watershed by not pausing mining claims in an area of southern B.C., despite the First Nation declaring it an Indigenous Protected Area in 2022.

all.title: 'Severe thunderstorm' rains down on parts of Metro Vancouver
all.description: Environment Canada issued a yellow warning for a "severe thunderstorm" for parts of Metro Vancouver. It said other areas that could be affected include Seymour Heights, Deep Cove and Mount Seymour Park.

all.title: 560 wildfires in B.C. have been classified as arson or suspicious since 2016: BCWS
all.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service says 3.8 per cent of wildfires are considered 'incendiary' fires, which means fires that were started either intentionally or by negligence. The cause of several major B.C. wildfires, including the Bald Range fire, are under investigation.

all.title: Wildfire near Summerland threatens mountain goats living on nearby cliffs
all.description: The B.C. government says a small herd of mountain goats are "thought to have escaped" the large wildfire that burns out of control near the evacuated community of Summerland.
